profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading on public markets under the ticker META. Its llama.com site presents the company as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. The site highlights several products: Muse Spark, described as optimized for coding tasks such as writing, reviewing, and shipping code with lower latency; Muse Image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing and is available through the Meta Model API at $0.01 per image; and support for multi-agent workflows that can interact with computer interfaces directly. The site also describes search grounding as a feature that gives models live web access via a single tool addition. Meta's Llama family is tracked as an open-weight model series that is often self-hosted.

Meta reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its 10-K filing, and holds SEC CIK number 0001326801. The company faces active litigation in multiple jurisdictions, including Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc., both in the Northern District of California, as well as Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas. The site's data associates Meta with 174 legal exposure entries in California. Several third-party MCP servers have been built around Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
